positioningCards.title: Asset Positioning
positioningCards.description: HE CALA is a regional operating platform for leisure-oriented owners in Caribbean and Latin America—not a generic global scale play. Concentrated in resort, all-inclusive, and urban/lifestyle assets rather than broad urban-only management.

positioningCards.title: Service Differentiation
positioningCards.description: Regional leadership (Corvinos, Register, Pergola) tied to Hotel Equities' broader platform: local knowledge, owner alignment, and a dedicated 2025 CALA division—distinct from a generic third-party remote model.

positioningCards.title: Execution Reliability
positioningCards.description: Owner-facing language emphasizes value creation and local execution. Institutional owners should view CALA depth as emerging (2025 launch) with continuity strength from Hotel Equities enterprise backing.

commercialEngine.title: Commercial Engine
commercialEngine.description: HE CALA pairs regional commercial leadership with Hotel Equities enterprise revenue management, distribution, and brand relationships—built for resort and lifestyle demand in Caribbean and Latin America.

items.title: Regional revenue leadership
items.description: In-market commercial accountability (e.g. Martha Estrada, Margie Aristy Mai) with pacing and forecast discipline on open CALA hotels.

items.title: Parent-platform commercial depth
items.description: HE training, brand relationships, and commercial support behind CALA—not a stand-alone regional sales office.

items.title: Brand-appropriate revenue stack
items.description: PMS/RMS/channel tooling varies by Marriott, Hilton, and Hyatt family flag; governance on discounting and channel mix.

items.title: Leisure & resort segmentation
items.description: Transient, group, and direct strategies aligned to island, all-inclusive, and urban lifestyle demand profiles.

items.title: Owner commercial reviews
items.description: Commercial business reviews with comp-set context and clear pacing narrative for ownership teams.

items.title: Performance-driven coordination
items.description: Tight linkage between operations and commercial disciplines on assets under CALA management.

ownerReporting.title: Owner Reporting & Communication
ownerReporting.description: Structured owner rhythm (monthly operating and financial reviews, quarterly CALA strategy sessions) even where public pack formats are not published—confirm detail in your management agreement.

items.title: Monthly owner operating review
items.description: P&L, forecast, labor and productivity, commercial pacing, and open issues—with materials in advance.

items.title: Quarterly CALA strategy touchpoint
items.description: Portfolio themes across Caribbean and Latin America markets, capex priorities, and brand strategy.

items.title: Finance leadership visibility
items.description: Regional finance (Martin Larralde, Mariana Gonzalez) and Mexico shared services support owner-ready variance bridges.

items.title: Lender-ready packs
items.description: Operating plans, forecasts, and capex trackers tailored to institutional lender requirements where applicable.

items.title: Action tracking
items.description: Decisions, owners, and due dates captured from reviews—not narrative-only reporting.

items.title: Emerging-platform transparency
items.description: Honest framing: CALA launched 2025—reporting maturity grows with open-hotel base; HE enterprise provides continuity.

preOpeningTransition.title: Pre-Opening & Transition Support
preOpeningTransition.description: CALA public materials emphasize openings, takeovers, and pipeline execution in DR, México, Turks & Caicos, Curaçao, and Costa Rica—including a first Costa Rica opening announced March 2026.

items.title: Pre-opening & openings leadership
items.description: Maria del Pilar Garcia (openings & IT) coordinates systems, staffing, and cutover with regional ops.

items.title: Pipeline market mobilization
items.description: Playbooks for island resort and lifestyle assets entering HE CALA management.

items.title: Trust Hospitality scale path
items.description: 2024 HE–Trust Hospitality partnership underpins dedicated CALA build-out for regional owners.

conversionRepositioning.title: Conversion & Repositioning
conversionRepositioning.description: Revenue and operating discipline during reflag, soft-brand, and repositioning windows—brand-appropriate systems with owner-visible stabilization milestones.
